opening.argument: The offering ties payment to mining-based returns: viewers are asked to pay a $99 membership, purchase miners priced from $500 to $3,500, and accept claims of 1,000 days of money or bitcoin earnings ranging from $10,000 to $70,000. The speaker links buying machines directly to earning bitcoin or money and says viewers will earn automatically day after day. The presentation also urges investment and directs viewers to contact the person who sent the video. Although the speaker calls the figures historical returns and notes that bitcoin prices vary, those qualifications do not remove the central promotion of paid mining packages and projected returns.
